item: Initial obliquity of the ecliptic at J2000.0
notes: IERS gives uncertainty 0.001 arcsec; this is the J2000 initial value, not a date-specific obliquity series.
Rounds to 23.44 degrees; not a measurement of any individual asteroid's orbital inclination.
The model describes near-ecliptic arrival and equatorial GEO but names no source or epoch.
The worksheet gives a geometry rationale but no named external reference or epoch; input_backing classifies an own-source constant without a named reference as needs.
